{ \"sku\": \"12345\", \"qty\": 50, \"warehouse_id\": \"W-01\" }

name: Error Matrix
description: Error handling workflows and retry logic for API timeouts.
preview:
ERROR HANDLING MATRIX
Error 404: Log error, alert admin.
Error 429 (Rate Limit): Exponential backoff (retry at 1s, 2s, 4s).
Error 500: Fallback to dead-letter queue.
